blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – The National ICT (Information and Communications Technology) Confederation of the Philippines (NICP) has reaffirmed its commitment to driving digital transformation in the countryside. During Monday’s opening of 11th Mindanao ICT Conference (MindaCon) 2026 from Nov. 9 to 11, NICP president Jessraf Palmares lauded the city government’s thrust toward digital innovation, emphasizing that selecting Pagadian City as the venue for this year’s regional summit aligns with the organization’s core mandate of countryside development. “Since 2008, it has been the mission of NICP to bring development to the countryside.
